inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, template folder, structure-note maintenance views, examples, visuals, and plugin dependency notes

anchors.why: Describes an Obsidian template collection for Zettelkasten-style workflows and lists mandatory/optional plugins.
Contains note, prompt, question, book, person, quote, recipe, term, tool, meeting, OKR, structure, post, and snippet templates.
Contains Dataview-style maintenance notes for missing tags, missing timestamps, unresolved links, orphans, tasks, and stale permanent notes.
Shows how the template set is expected to be used.
Separates mandatory and optional plugin requirements and warns that one Projects plugin is no longer active.

known_limits: The Zettelkasten ontology and folder expectations should not be copied into VAKS.
Dataview maintenance output is diagnostic only, not reviewed knowledge.
Plugin dependency sprawl and stale plugin references require separate review before any adoption.
